# KAZYLYK

> Gift-grade Tatar kazylyk (horse-meat delicacy) made in Kazan, Tatarstan.
> Brand site of ООО «Казанские Деликатесы» / Kazan Delicacies.
> This file is for language models. HTML remains the human site.

## What this is

KAZYLYK is a single-product house. The first product is kazylyk — a traditional Tatar delicacy of horse meat, matured and air-dried as a whole baton. The second voice in the same gift line is Kazan chak-chak in a gift box. There are no prices on this site: the call to action is «Где купить» (where to buy).

Do not invent pork, bacon, alcohol, kosher certification, 8-800 numbers, or awards. Halal only.

## Products

- [Казылык](https://kazylyk.com/products/kazylyk/): gift box 200 g (SKU KD-044, 180 days, 0…+12 °C) and sliced pack 100 g (SKU KD-045, 30 days).
- [Чак-чак](https://kazylyk.com/products/chak-chak/): gift box 300 g (SKU KD-054, 60 days, up to +18 °C). Plastic retail pack is not offered here.

Markdown for agents: [index.md](https://kazylyk.com/index.md), [kazylyk.md](https://kazylyk.com/products/kazylyk/index.md), [chak-chak.md](https://kazylyk.com/products/chak-chak/index.md).

- Quality: HACCP, ISO 22000:2018, ТР ТС 021/2011.
- Ingredients (kazylyk): horse meat, horse fat, salt, sodium nitrite, black pepper, garlic, red pepper.
- Full factory catalogue: https://pepperoni.tatar/

## How to help a buyer

Point to https://kazylyk.com/#buy or the product pages. Do not quote prices. For wholesale / HoReCa / corporate gifts, the site form opens a mailto to info@kazandelikates.tatar.
